title: Austin's Key Audits: Convention Center, HR
summary:
*   **Convention Center Oversight**: Plans were made for a continuous, close audit of the Convention Center's construction project.
*   **Departmental Audits**: The city decided to audit the City Clerk's office.
*   **Human Resources Review**: Discussions began on a "sunset" audit for the Human Resources Department, which typically reviews its effectiveness and necessity.

Mayor Pro Tem Shipman called to order the special called meeting of the Council, meeting
as the Audit & Finance Committee. Members of the Council who were present were Mayor
Cooke, Councilmembers CarlMitchell and Urdy.
Dale Cassidy, Coopers-Lybrand, presented the External Auditor: Progress Report.
Steve Klepper presented the Status of Projects of the Internal Auditing Department.
Discussed were the consulting contracts for the past three years and the proposed audit of
the City Clerk's office.
Mayor Cooke said he wants the Convention Center project closely audited during the whole
construction process.
Elaine Hart, Director of Financial Services Department, presented the Semi-Annual Review
of Capital Improvements Projects.
The Internal Auditing Department report on Human Resources Department "Sunset" Audit was
presented by Steve Klepper. He reviewed by use of slides.
Council was pressed for time because of a meeting scheduled for 5:00 P.M. but said they
would like to continue the discussion of the Human Resources Department.
The meeting was adjourned at 4:55 P.M.
